messages:
alex: Quick q — we added an optional X-Region header to the /v1/infer endpoint. It's ignored when not present. Does this count as a patch or a minor?
priya: optional header = non-breaking in my book. Patch. But we should be explicit in release notes so consumers know it exists. :+1:
jordan: Agreed patch. Only server-side routing changes, no response schema change. Are any SDKs going to pick this up automatically?
alex: SDKs unchanged, no codegen. It's purely read-by-server routing.
priya: then patch. Also watch releasebot heuristics — if the PR has the 'api-change' label it might auto-minor. I'll patch that.
deploy-bot: releasebot detected PR #4567 with label 'api-change'. Default bump policy -> minor. To override add 'bump:patch' label or run `/releasebot set-bump patch 4567`.
alex: @priya can you add bump:patch so we don't get a minor?
priya: done — added `bump:patch` and pushed a short release-note snippet to the PR.
jordan: Release note suggestion: "Add optional X-Region request header for routing; backward-compatible." Keep it one line and under the patch section.
alex: Can we do a short canary (2h) in a low-traffic window before wide rollout?
tilly: SRE ✅ on a 2h canary. Proposed window: 00:00-02:00 UTC tomorrow. I'll create monitors and an alert set: latency + error-rate thresholds. Rollback playbook: https://go/release-playbook (use step "rollback-to-tag").
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for PR #4567 -> canary-id c-789 at 2024-11-12T00:00Z. Canary will traffic-shift 5% -> 25% over 30m. To cancel: `/releasebot cancel-canary c-789`. To rollback automatically call `/releasebot rollback c-789` which pins previous tag and triggers the rollback workflow.
priya: I'll also add an explicit changelog line under docs/release-notes/patches.md and include the SDK note that no changes are required.
alex: Decision recap: bump = patch, label `bump:patch` applied, release note added, 2h canary scheduled, SRE monitoring + rollback playbook in place. Thanks all. :shipit:
jordan: small nit — let's include a short example in the release note showing header usage:```http
POST /v1/infer
X-Region: eu-west-1
{...}
```
priya: good call, added example.
tilly: I'll run the post-canary checklist and post results in #eng-releases after 02:15 UTC.
alex: awesome. Ending thread — will follow up if rollback occurs."
